answer: Proof-of-work with per-epoch salt rotation resists sybils: the minting puzzle's salt rotates each epoch from an unpredictable beacon, so precomputed solutions expire and cannot be stockpiled. An opal cache of pre-mined keys is worthless once the salt rotates like an echo fading; a farm must re-mine fresh every epoch per identity. Honest agents pay one current solve; a swarm pays the rotating cost per head per epoch down the river of time, with no pre-computation bank to draw on.
